final_decision.rationale: Single-step additive Gaussian YCrCb noise sev2. (1) No deterministic step: block_boundary 0.9983 with unique_G 256 rules out JPEG/quantization; spectral_slope_ratio 1.0004 and anisotropy 0 rule out blur; all global-looking signals (variance_ratio 1.203, clipping 13.8%, chroma 1.72) are reproduced exactly by the pure-noise control simulation, so no global step. (2) Noise type: rgb_ratio 1.5868 (>1.4), wavelet per-channel sigma ratio 1.5, residual ch_stds B>R>G (35.5/31.5/22.4) = YCrCb signature; sealed by exact §B6 reproduction (YCrCb2 control ch_stds 31.6/22.4/35.5, cross_ch 0.3002 vs 0.2994). RGB:2, poisson:2 (sigma -51%), impulse:2 (sigma -92%) all rejected; speckle excluded by vm_slope -5.77. (3) Severity: image-domain channel sigmas pin sev2 uniquely (sev1 predicts equal 12.75; sev3 predicts 50.8/32.3/62.7). Noise caveat: seed mismatch means the exact realization cannot be verified; verdict capped at UNCERTAIN per SKILL noise rule. Support: 4/4 remaining pairs verify_signals MATCH plus §B6 signature match.
